name: Churn Explorer
prompt: I'm analyzing customer churn. Build a data explorer layout with a left sidebar containing complex filtering options for Account Age, Subscription Tier, and Last Login Date. The main canvas should have a dense scatter plot showing Account Age vs Lifetime Value, and a heatmap showing churn correlation across geographical regions.

thought_process.interpretation: The user wants a high-fidelity 'Data Investigator' application archetype focused on customer churn analysis. I will prioritize deep interactivity, complex sidebar filtering, and high-density visualizations (Scatter and Heatmap). The goal is to allow an analyst to slice the data by account characteristics and observe correlations with LTV and regional churn patterns.
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A dedicated 'ui/components/sidebar_layout.md' would be useful to standardize the spacing and transition logic for collapsible investigation panels. Also, a 'ui/components/range_slider.md' would better support numeric interval filtering like Account Age.
